final_message:
All visible tests pass and documented edge cases check out. Bugs fixed:

1. **`ledger/money.py` – `format_cents`**: negative cents used floor division/modulo, so `format_cents(-310)` produced `-$-4.90` instead of `-$3.10`; now formats from `abs(cents)` with the sign prefixed (`-$0.05` style).
2. **`ledger/parse.py` – `parse_date`**: returned `(y, d, m)` — month and day were swapped; now returns `(year, month, day)`.
3. **`ledger/report.py` – `top_items`**: sorted totals ascending and returned the smallest n, with no tie-break; now sorts by total descending with ties broken by item name ascending, as documented (`summary_line` inherits the fix).
